item.title: SIPRI hosts discussion on human security and AI
item.description: On 20 October 2026, SIPRI convened an online event exploring how artificial intelligence (AI) can advance peacebuilding. The event was part of the Community of Practice on Human Security, a joint initiative by SIPRI and the United Nations Trust Fund for Human Security (UNTFHS).
